entity.summary: Canadian centralized cryptocurrency trading platform providing current buy, sell, limit-order, funding, withdrawal, and custody access.
entity.notes: First-party materials identify Netcoins Inc. as a Canadian platform founded in Vancouver in 2014 and owned by BIGG Digital Assets. A provincial regulator lists Netcoins among registered Canadian crypto trading platforms. No exact launch day is asserted.

evidence.title: Netcoins About Us
evidence.notes: Confirms the Canadian trading platform, 2014 founding year, current services, registrations, and ownership.

evidence.notes: Lists Netcoins Inc. among platforms registered to operate in Canada.
